name: Iman Mohammadi
tagline: Building scalable web experiences, UI systems and immersive 3D applications.

projects.title: Raya UI
projects.tagline: A copy-paste Vue and Nuxt component library built on accessible primitives.
projects.description: A modern Vue and Nuxt component library focused on reusable, customizable and accessible UI components. Components are built on Reka UI primitives, copied into your project so you own the code, and come with a developer-friendly installation and documentation experience.
projects.imageAlt: Raya UI home page: the RAYA wordmark on a dark background

projects.title: Woodcoder
projects.tagline: Design your own furniture in an interactive 3D configurator.
projects.description: A 3D product configuration platform that enables users to customize furniture and products through interactive 3D scenes and configurable product rules. Customers design beds, wardrobes, cabinets and more, then order flat-pack pieces made to their dimensions.
projects.imageAlt: Woodcoder home page showing a 3D chest of drawers

projects.title: Hotelyar
projects.tagline: Online hotel booking across Iran, in Persian and English.
projects.description: A hotel booking platform with multilingual support and a modern user experience for discovering and booking accommodation: search by city or hotel, compare prices, photos and traveller reviews, and book online.
projects.imageAlt: Hotelyar home page with hotel search

projects.title: Tricup
projects.tagline: AI-powered football predictions and match analysis.
projects.description: An AI-powered football prediction and match analysis platform designed to provide users with football insights and interactive analysis features.

projects.title: TinyHub
projects.tagline: Minimal browser tools for developers: JSON formatter and more.
projects.description: A lightweight collection of browser-based utilities for developers, including a JSON formatter and beautifier, text sharing and a link shortener, in a distraction-free interface.

projects.title: Rizo Tools
projects.tagline: 43 private, client-side developer tools in one place.
projects.description: A collection of online tools and utilities for developers: 43 client-side tools for JSON, encoding, security, dates and Persian text. Everything runs in the browser, with no uploads and no accounts.

projects.title: Rizo Weather
projects.tagline: Current weather, hourly and 10-day forecasts in the browser.
projects.description: A web-based weather application for checking weather conditions and forecasts: current temperature, feels-like, wind, humidity, UV, sunrise and sunset, air quality, plus hourly and 10-day forecasts, maps and historical data.
projects.imageAlt: Rizo Weather showing current weather in Tehran

projects.title: 3D Car Portfolio
projects.tagline: A personal portfolio you explore by driving through a 3D city.
projects.description: An interactive personal portfolio experience presented through a 3D car and a game-like environment, allowing visitors to explore professional information through an immersive interface. A plain-text version of the portfolio is available too.
projects.imageAlt: 3D Car Portfolio intro screen over a low-poly city
